lines.zh: 我在白桦林里走，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I walk the birch wood. Light steps.

lines.zh: 白色的树干，和我身上的布很配。
lines.en: White trunks suit this robe of mine.

lines.zh: 我一走，林子就安静下来。
lines.en: As I walk, the wood falls quiet.
Step by step, as if measuring.

lines.zh: 我的长耳朵垂着，随步摆。
lines.en: My long ears hang and sway.
I go around the birches without touching.
Slow, but never pausing.
The fallen leaves don't stir under me.

lines.zh: 这一片林，是我选的地方。
lines.en: I chose this wood.
I head deeper. At ease.

lines.zh: 我身上的光，照在树皮上。
lines.en: My light falls on the bark.
I go on. No looking back.
I stand among the birches. Very still.

lines.zh: 我把手举到胸前，像在念。
lines.en: I raise my hands to my chest, as if reciting.
Wind through the birches. Leaves sound.

lines.zh: 我在等，等林子给我信号。
lines.en: I wait for the wood to signal.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵慢慢转向一边。
lines.en: My ears turn slowly to one side.

lines.zh: 我身上的布，被风吹起一点。
lines.en: Wind lifts my robe a little.
No hurry. It's peaceful here.
I mimic the Deva's poise.
I count the birches. Twenty.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在白树上，很淡。
lines.en: My shadow on the white trunks is faint.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看自己的掌。
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my palm.

lines.zh: 这片白桦林，今天只有我。
lines.en: This birch wood holds only me today.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我听见远处有水。
lines.en: In the birch wood, I hear water far off.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一根白色的柱子。
lines.en: I stand like a white pillar.
Few walk into the birch wood.
Head lowered, now I can see you clearly.
Your steps crush the fallen leaves.
I raise a hand for you to stop there.
This wood dislikes noise.
Your smell doesn't belong here.
My long ears turn; I face you squarely.
Leave, and I won't follow.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，我数到第七下。
lines.en: Your breaths — I've counted seven.

lines.zh: 白桦林归我护，你站着别动。
lines.en: I guard this birch wood; stand still.
I guard these birches.

lines.zh: 我只看你的膝盖和脚踝。
lines.en: I watch only your knees and ankles.
If you speak, keep it quiet.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我最恨被打断。
lines.en: In the birch wood, I hate being interrupted.
Standing like that, you're quiet enough.

lines.zh: 白桦林的风，把我的毛吹顺了。
lines.en: Birch wind has smoothed my fur.

lines.zh: 布衣晃了一下，我又站定。
lines.en: My cloth robe sways; I steady again.
My shoulder plate cracks, but I don't loose the haft.
I even muffle my breathing.
My hat is knocked askew; I set it straight.
Leaning on my axe, I straighten up.

lines.zh: 斧柄在掌心滑了一下，我攥住。
lines.en: The haft slips in my palm; I grip it.
I fold my hands to steady myself.
You hit harder than expected.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，目光还在你身上。
lines.en: I raise my head, eyes still on you.

lines.zh: 白毛底下渗出血，我忍着。
lines.en: Blood seeps through white fur; I endure it.
Nothing like this grows here.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你把东西收回去。
lines.en: I raise a hand; you put it away.
The fruit you hold out, I won't take.

lines.zh: 我一身白毛，是玉兔的样。
lines.en: All white fur, like a jade rabbit.
That won't buy my passage.
Ears flattened — that's me holding back.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，这个换不来我的让路。
lines.en: Keep it; this will not buy my way.
I don't know that smell.
My robe has no room for that.
I stay still, waiting for you to stop.
That's of no use to the wood.
I turn my head away.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，被我的肩弹开。
lines.en: You charge in and bounce off my shoulder.
I stand. Not a hair moved.
I angle aside to open the way.

lines.zh: 这一下，白桦叶落了几片。
lines.en: A few birch leaves fall.
Don't touch the Deva's cloth.
I raise a hand to block.
This collision will numb your wrist.
One step back, and I set my axe upright.

lines.zh: 我的长耳能听见背后的呼吸。
lines.en: My long ears hear the breath behind me.
You stepped on a birch twig.

lines.zh: 白桦之间，这样的很少见。
lines.en: Rare among the birches.

lines.zh: 我的手伸过去，她的爪子搭上。
lines.en: I reach out; her paw settles on mine.

lines.zh: 两件布衣并在一起，很白。
lines.en: Two robes together. Very white.
This feels even more like a rite.
Neither speaks. Only wind.
The birches stand as witnesses.
This will stay in the wood.

lines.zh: 天亮前，我们各自回林子里。
lines.en: Before dawn, we each return to the woods.
Its ears are whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 她走远了，我还站在原地。
lines.en: She's gone far, and I still stand here.

lines.zh: 我弯腰，斧子先靠稳树根。
lines.en: I bend down, first resting my axe on the roots.
It won't bite through, so back on the ground.
I set it by a birch root.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂，很轻，比斧柄轻。
lines.en: I weigh it; lighter than my axe haft.

lines.zh: 这块太小，我的手指夹不住。
lines.en: Too small; my fingers can't pinch it.

lines.zh: 这片白桦林，跟我身上的布很配。
lines.en: This birch grove matches the cloth on me.
The smell of wood beats the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 我把它摆在你脚边的石上。
lines.en: I set it on the stone by your feet.

lines.zh: 林子里的东西，我只取够用。
lines.en: From the wood I take only what I need.

lines.zh: 我递过去，你接不接随你。
lines.en: I offer it. Take it or not.
You shouldn't have come in.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，两格的完全体。
lines.en: A two-block Perfect stage in the birches.
I keep these birches.
I come closer. Steady.

lines.zh: 我手里那把斧，是神授的。
lines.en: The axe in my hand is divine.

lines.zh: 耳朵压平，我已经决定了。
lines.en: Ears flat — my mind is made up.

lines.zh: 你退到林子边，就没路了。
lines.en: Back to the treeline and there's nowhere.
Gripping the haft, I wait for you to step in.
When I raise my hand, it glows.

lines.zh: 你的斧子举起来，我的也会。
lines.en: Raise your axe and mine rises too.

lines.zh: 从你进林子，我就没眨眼。
lines.en: Since you entered the wood, I haven't blinked.
This isn't personal.
Birch woods are easy to hide in.
You go left and I turn left.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，踩着苔藓过来。
lines.en: Step by step, I come over the moss.
No hurry. You won't get out.
Andiramon's ears swivel toward you.
I hold my hands up, waiting.
You shift an inch; I follow an inch.
I know these birches better than you.

lines.zh: 风一吹，你的味道就淡了。
lines.en: The wind thins your scent away.

lines.zh: 再走一步，我的斧就到了。
lines.en: One more step and my axe arrives.
Shadow won't help you.
Against you, I needn't swing fast.
I bring my hand down. Light falls.

lines.zh: 这一斧下去，树桩都裂了。
lines.en: One axe blow splits even the stump.

lines.zh: 我这一斧下去，土都翻开。
lines.en: One axe blow turns up the soil.
My strength exceeds my look.
I strike true. Nothing wasted.
Afterward I draw back half a step.

lines.zh: 斧背贴着你的肩甲滑过。
lines.en: The flat of my axe slides past your pauldron.
My ears didn't move.
You retreat behind a birch, and I lower my axe.
I dislike saying it twice.
That shook the birches too.
I stand. My breathing's unchanged.
I step out from between the birches.

lines.zh: 我先听了听林子的声音。
lines.en: First I listen to the wood.
The white here is cleaner than elsewhere.

lines.zh: 白桦林里，我的布衣最显眼。
lines.en: In the birches, my cloth shows most.
The light on me brightens.

lines.zh: 布鞋踩过落叶，一点声都没有。
lines.en: My cloth shoes cross the leaves without a sound.

lines.zh: 白桦树皮一样白的，只有我。
lines.en: Only I am as white as the birch bark.
I stand straight, long ears drooping to my shoulders.
I open my palm: only wood shavings.
Wind through the birches. Cool.

lines.zh: 白桦林的边界，我走了一圈。
lines.en: I walked the birch forest's edge.
This is mine from today.
Fire curls my robe.
I fall from a tree and my legs jar.
Water to my chest. My hands won't lift.
The blast throws me into a birch.
It's in my arm. I leave it.

lines.zh: 光缠住我的手臂，斧落不下去。
lines.en: Light binds my arm; the axe won't fall.
Empty belly makes the axe heavier.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，整条臂都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 我的布鞋踩空，直往下坠。
lines.en: My cloth shoe finds nothing; I fall.
